steps.script: (async()=>{var users=['mckim2','mckim3','review_user01','admin','operator'];var strip=document.createElement('div');strip.id='__pb_strip';strip.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:99999;background:#fff;padding:16px;display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:2px solid #111;font:12px sans-serif;color:#111;';var title=document.createElement('div');title.textContent='gc-avatar-identicon: 무아바타=Identicon, id35=실제 이미지';title.style.cssText='width:100%;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;';strip.appendChild(title);function cell(el,lbl){var w=document.createElement('div');w.style.cssText='display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;';el.style.width='44px';el.style.height='44px';el.style.marginRight='0';w.appendChild(el);var s=document.createElement('span');s.textContent=lbl;w.appendChild(s);return w;}users.forEach(function(u){strip.appendChild(cell(_msgAvatarEl(0,u,'user','',u),u));});strip.appendChild(cell(_msgAvatarEl(35,'dgwe','user','','dgwe'),'id35(업로드)'));strip.appendChild(cell(_msgAvatarEl(0,'','assistant','',''),'assistant(auto)'));document.body.appendChild(strip);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));return JSON.stringify({stripRendered:true,cells:users.length+2});})()
